selection_rationale: cand-7f3a2 (End-to-end Generate→Verify→Repair) best matches the documented gap (G1) and the evidence base for GVR-style pipelines (E3/E1) while being highly relevant to CNSM’s NetOps safety remit. It is falsifiable, experimentally concrete, and feasible given available emulators/verifiers (references: doi:10.2139/ssrn.6754899; doi:10.1002/nem.2313; doi:10.20535/2411-2976.12021.24-32; doi:10.21203/rs.3.rs-8123173/v1). Reviewers rate it high for venue relevance and novelty but require design repairs (see list).
unresolved_uncertainties: Deterministic verifier ruleset coverage vs real-world network policies (possible blind spots).
Emulator fidelity (Mininet/vendor-equivalent) for detecting semantic/policy violations and mapping verifier flags to emulator tests.
Risk that LLM repair iterations introduce secondary unsafe constructs not captured by verifier rules.
Dataset sourcing and sampling bias for the N=100 intents (representativeness across vendors/intents).
Statistical power/sample-size sufficiency for the paired-proportion test and planned subgroup analyses.
Exact mapping and adjudication process for verifier-detected violations vs emulator-confirmed failures (false positives/negatives).
required_repairs_before_preregistration: Specify deterministic network verifier (e.g., Batfish) including exact version, configuration, and rule-engine settings.
Publish the verifier ruleset provenance and formalize how safety policies are encoded and validated (coverage statement and examples).
Provide explicit emulator/testbed specification (Mininet or vendor-equivalent), full test-suite scripts, topology templates, and how emulator tests confirm each verifier flag.
Define dataset sourcing and intent-sampling procedure with inclusion/exclusion rules; publish or snapshot the intent corpus with stable identifiers for reproducibility.

Pre-register exact prompt templates, the repair-prompting strategy (repair prompt templates, condition-to-prompt mapping), model(s)/model-identifiers, allowed model-call budget, random seeds, and retry policy (max iterations).
Conduct and report a power analysis/sample-size justification for primary and pre-registered subgroup analyses; pre-register statistical tests and multiple-comparison corrections.
Pre-register mapping from verifier-detected violation types to concrete emulator checks and the adjudication procedure for discordant verifier/emulator outcomes.
Provide an artifact-sharing and reproducibility plan (which artifacts will be public, formats, redaction policy to avoid accidental release of unsafe commands).
